paragraphs: Welcome to my academic portfolio. I am Nahin — a Computer Vision researcher and educator holding a B.Sc. in Computer Science & Engineering from Khulna University of Engineering & Technology (KUET). Currently, I serve as a Lecturer at Bangladesh Army University of Science & Technology, Khulna (BAUSTK), where I share my passion for cutting-edge technologies with the next generation of engineers.

My primary research is centred on Computer Vision and Machine Learning, with multiple published works spanning deep learning-based license plate recognition, vehicle classification, image colorization, and environmental quality prediction. I thrive on bridging theoretical foundations with real-world applications.

Beyond research, I bring leadership experience from my tenure as President of the Jashore Association of KUET (JAK), and I find creative expression through photography — a discipline that sharpens the same attention to detail I bring to my academic work.
I invite you to explore my work and connect to discuss potential collaborations in computer vision or academic initiatives.

publications.title: Gray Scale to Color Image Conversion using Generative Adversarial Networks
publications.venue: Under review in a Q1 journal
publications.text: This study explores image colorization using deep learning, particularly conditional Generative Adversarial Networks (cGANs), which outperform traditional reference-based methods by generating realistic colors more efficiently and without requiring manual reference images.

publications.title: Comparative Analysis of Machine Learning Models for Predicting Water Quality Index in Dhaka's Rivers of Bangladesh
publications.venue: Environmental Sciences Europe · Springer Nature · IF: 6.0 (2023)
publications.text: Fourteen machine learning models were evaluated for predicting the Water Quality Index (WQI) in Dhaka's key rivers. ANN and Random Forest Regressor demonstrated the highest accuracy — offering a reliable, cost-effective method for environmental monitoring and policy decision-making.

publications.title: Automatic License Plate Recognition System for Bangladeshi Vehicles Using Deep Neural Network
publications.text: An optimal end-to-end ALPR system for Bangladeshi vehicles trained on a novel dataset. A custom algorithm eliminates the segmentation phase, yielding 99.37% accuracy in plate localization and 96.31% in text recognition. Awarded Best Paper in the Machine Learning track.

publications.title: Bangladeshi Local Vehicle Recognition with a Comprehensive Dataset using Transfer Learning Techniques
publications.text: A challenging dataset of Bangladeshi vehicles was developed for ITS tasks. Various pre-trained models were evaluated; the proposed model achieved leading results in both localization and categorization, better reflecting real-life scenarios than pre-existing alternatives.

projects.title: Automatic License Plate Recognizer
projects.text: An end-to-end AI pipeline for detecting Bangladeshi license plates and recognising inscribed characters. Results are logged to CSV. Seven DNN architectures were benchmarked before arriving at the final optimised configuration.

projects.title: Kill The Man — OpenGL Game
projects.text: A 2D video game in C++ with OpenGL as a Computer Graphics laboratory project. The gameplay involves intercepting a target character passing through the scene by vehicle.

projects.title: Home Rental Web Platform
projects.text: A web application where tenants can search for available properties by location, and owners can list vacant houses. Built with PHP and MySQLi, hosted locally via XAMPP.

projects.title: Ghorbari — Android Housing App
projects.text: An Android application enabling location-based property discovery for tenants and advertisement tools for owners. Built with Java and Firebase as a real-time backend.
